displayName: DiamondEcho SRE: uptime check failing from 2 or more places

documentation.subject: DiamondEcho: a page or the API is failing from more than one place
documentation.content:
A Cloud Monitoring uptime check (deploy/monitoring/uptime-checks/) has failed from at least two checker locations at once. One location failing is usually that location's network; two or more is the site.

This is the second, independent watch: it runs in Google Cloud, not on GitHub, so it still rings when the GitHub monitor is blind or stopped.

What to do: open the incident's check id in Monitoring > Uptime checks to see which page, then follow the runbook for it in docs/sre/runbooks/ (site-down.md for pages, api-down.md for the API, search-provider-down.md for the search page). The GitHub incident issue, if one is open, is the place to write what you find.

This message carries no visitor data.
